title: SDC-MCP Gateway: Software and Evaluation Artifacts
description:
Source code and frozen evaluation artifacts for the research prototype described in A Safety-Bounded SDC-to-MCP Gateway for Medical AI Agents, by Bennet Gerlach and Stefan Fischer.

The gateway exposes simulated and software-reference IEEE 11073 SDC device state through read-only Model Context Protocol resources and policy-checked, non-executing tools. The archive contains the unchanged source tree of tag v2.0.0-rc1 (commit 4cf508eee7c70b8fa7873f6ce457e6407e99f0e7), scenarios, prompts, graders, recorded model responses, representation comparisons, and protocol and deterministic safety evidence, with corrected citation metadata and checksum verification instructions.

The frozen five-model evaluation records 414/420 passed cases. Protocol evidence covers Python/Python and independent Java SDCri/Python software-reference configurations. The consolidation reuses the frozen external-model outputs rather than rerunning them. This is simulation and software-reference evidence, not physical-device validation, clinical validation, a certified medical device, or support for autonomous therapy.

The archival version is 2.0.0-rc1; the evaluated source retains internal Python package version 0.13.0. Historical files are preserved, including older citation metadata; the top-level citation file supplies the corrected author order and release reference. No arXiv or journal publication is claimed by this deposit.
